## SECURITIESAND FUTURES COMMISSION 證券及期貨事務察委員会

## 2 August 2011

## Circular to Licensed Corporations in relation to HKMA's consultation on logistical and technical arrangements for the reporting of OTC derivatives transactions to the Hong Kong trade repository

In line with global initiatives to reform the OTC derivatives market, the Securities and Futures Commission  ( SFC ) on 10 December  2010  announced  that  it  would  work  with the Government,  the  Hong  Kong  Monetary  Authority  ( HKMA ),  Hong  Kong  Exchanges  and Clearing Limited ( HKEx )  and relevant stakeholders to build a regulatory regime that would require (among other things) -

- (a)  the reporting of OTC derivatives transactions to a trade repository in Hong Kong, and
- (b)  the  clearing  of  standardised  OTC  derivatives  transactions  through  authorised  central counterparties.

The HKMA also announced on that day that it would establish a trade repository ( HKTR ).

Work  on  developing  the  regulatory regime  for  OTC  derivatives  is  underway  and  a consultation  will  be  launched  later  this  year.  In  the  meantime,  the  HKMA  wishes  to  seek comments on certain logistical and technical matters relating to its proposed HKTR and has issued a consultation paper in this regard ( HKMA consultation paper ).

As  the  new  regime  will  apply  to  persons  who  participate  in  the  OTC  derivatives  market, including  therefore  Licensed  Corporations  who  participate  in  that  market,  the  HKMA  also welcomes comments from interested Licensed Corporations.

The HKMA consultation paper is attached to this circular. Licensed Corporations that wish to participate in this consultation may do so by submitting their comments to the HKMA on or before 9 September 2011 .

The HKMA will be organising a series of briefing sessions to facilitate a better understanding of  the  logistical  and  technical  arrangements  described  in  the  HKMA  consultation  paper.  If your institution is interested in attending the briefing session, kindly complete and return the enclosed reply slip to the HKMA on or before 10 August 2011 .

Should you have any queries regarding the above, please contact the HKMA  at hktr@hkma.gov.hk.
